fact: The 2025 update of the IFAD diagnostic says most remittances to Senegal are still cash over the counter, digital receipt in e-money wallets is rising through partnerships such as WorldRemit-Wizzall-Ria-Orange Money, and the average cost of sending USD 200 is 3.5% (Q1 2024).
title: RemitSCOPE Africa Senegal country diagnostic
